observations.content: Assistant planned and implemented a shared status renderer buildStatusLines in src/commands/status.ts as single source of truth for both /om:status command and om_status tool, with a verdict line up front, ratios instead of bare numbers, and per-role cost attribution.

Assistant wrote new src/commands/status.ts (4376 bytes) with buildStatusLines and registerStatusCommand; verdict logic: ⏳ working when consolidatorInFlight or observers running, ⚠ for warnings (lastWorkerError, pool >= 90% of consolidateAtPoolTokens, context >= 80% of compactAtContextTokens), else ✓ healthy.

Assistant added sumSessionCostByRole function to src/ledger/types.ts (after sumSessionCost) returning total/observer/consolidator RoleCostSummary with costUsd and runs, tallying cost entries by data.role.

Assistant checked imports: observer-trigger.ts:19 already imports readWorkerCost, runCostPath, runResultPath from ../spawn/runs.js; consolidator-trigger did not import them (only called recordWorkerCost from observer-trigger).

Assistant rewrote status-tool.ts execute body to use shared buildStatusLines + renderTimeline, reading branch via ctx.sessionManager.getBranch() and contextTokens via optional ctx.getContextUsage?.()?.tokens ?? null.
Assistant edited 3 hook timeline strings in observer-trigger.ts, consolidator-trigger.ts, compaction-trigger.ts via python replace with asserts (all matched).

New observer-trigger timeline wording: start 'om: observer started — summarizing ~Xk tok of chat…'; done line 'om: observer done: N observations from ~Xk tok · $Y this run · session $Z (N runs)' using readWorkerCost per-run; UI toast 'om: observer done: +N observations'.

consolidator-trigger.ts got new import line readWorkerCost/runCostPath from ../spawn/runs.js; new wording: start 'om: consolidator folding N observations (~Xk tok) into durable topic files…'; done line per-run cost; toast 'om: consolidator done: N obs → topics'.
compaction-trigger.ts new wording: 'om: context full — compacting (waiting for ${runtime.observersInFlight.size} running observer(s))…' and 'om: compaction complete ✓'.

Assistant created tests/status-lines.test.ts (2140 bytes) with 4 buildStatusLines tests: healthy verdict with per-role cost split, warning on lastWorkerError, working verdict while observer in flight, and '?' for unknown context.

Initial test run: 1 fail, 216 expect() calls, 112 tests across 16 files; TS error TS2300 Duplicate identifier 'renderTimeline' in status-tool.ts (lines 12 and 15) from import surgery; demo report rendered correctly with '⏳ working — 1/4 observers' and per-role cost split.

Assistant fixed both issues: deduped the renderTimeline import in status-tool.ts and changed test expectation from (40%) to (67%) because DEFAULTS.compactAtContextTokens is 150_000 making 100k/150k = 67%.

Completed: 112/112 tests pass (108 old + 4 new), bunx tsc --noEmit clean (TSC_CLEAN), synced status.ts, status-tool.ts, ledger/types.ts, 3 hooks, and test file to live path /home/coder/workspaces/learn/.pi/extensions/observational-memory/.
Assistant demoed report with real evening numbers: session $0.2320 (4 runs), observer $0.0120 (3 runs), consolidator $0.2200 (1 runs), topics 8, journey none yet, context 141,200/250,000 tok (56%).

Assistant explained new timeline wording in Vietnamese to user, highlighting each done line shows that run's cost (e.g. $0.0031 this run) separate from session cumulative, and noted one consolidator run can equal 70 normal observers.

Assistant told user one Paseo restart is needed to pick up all evening changes: new status report, ask_question 300s, and compactAtContextTokens 250k (config read at extension load), because process has not loaded saved code.

Live om:status report after change rendered real data: ⚠ pool 97% — consolidation imminent, context 138,098/250,000 tok (55%), topics 7, journey ~3,212/1,000 tok, session $0.4721 (45 runs), observer $0.0476 (40 runs), consolidator $0.4245 (5 runs), timeline 407.5k raw, 3 compactions.

User asked assistant to simulate how billing and agent behavior would differ for the same usage with compactAtContextTokens at 150k vs 250k, provide evaluation criteria to compare the two options, assuming a very long session; user is still interested in the context increase from 150k to 250k.
